name: 090-rotated-land-45-inside
why: A 4.0x1.0 land at 45deg. Under the KiCad clockwise placement convention its long axis runs along (0.7071, -0.7071). The point (1.0, -1.0) projects 1.414mm along that axis (half-length 2.0) and 0mm across it (half-width 0.5): inside. The opposite sign convention would put it 1.414mm across.
